meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文字内容变成生动的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文章或笔记快速变成讲解视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into an engaging explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos quickly

howto.what: 装上后，你给一段文章、笔记或主题，它会生成一部“无脸”解说视频：画面不靠实拍或网站截图，而是按场景用排版、抽象图形、图表等设计；流程包括建项目、写故事板、配语音、渲染成视频。
howto.when: 当你要把一段文本做成解说类视频（主题解说、概念拆解、教程、列表清单），且不涉及产品/网站展示时触发；若意图不明会先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成90秒无脸解说视频。
say.note: 启动项目并逐步产出故事板和视频。

say.text: 用抽象图形把这几个概念做成教程视频，加男声旁白。
say.note: 会选对应声音并生成视觉帧。

say.text: 不要旁白，只配背景音乐，做一条无脸解说。
say.note: 项目会以无声模式处理，只保留BGM。

howto.what_en: Given an article, notes, or a topic, it produces a faceless explainer video: no live footage or website capture; visuals are designed per scene using typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, etc. The workflow covers project setup, storyboard, narration, and rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide text to turn into an explainer video (topic explainer, concept breakdown, how-to, listicle) not involving a product/website; if unclear, it goes through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a 90-second faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Starts the project and produces storyboard and video.

say_en.text: Make a tutorial video for these concepts with abstract graphics and a male voiceover.
say_en.note: Picks a matching voice and generates visual frames.

say_en.text: Make a faceless explainer with no narration, only background music.
say_en.note: Treats the project as silent, keeping only BGM.
